reason: A is the better proposal because W substitution is physically plausible in a refractory BCC alloy and is testable over the cited dynamic-loading range, although its phonon-drag, precipitation, and quantitative-strength claims need validation. B is undermined by proposing coherent FCC-derived L1₂ precipitates through heat treatment alone in Hf–Zr–Ti–Ta, a BCC refractory system lacking established L1₂-forming chemistry, while citing evidence from a compositionally and structurally dissimilar Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni alloy.
